propositions: BindingStore embeds multiple cohesive lifecycle decisions (forward/reverse transitions, pending/confirmed state, ID re-key, comment identity, absence grace, tombstones, unretire) that should be extracted into a private policy owner
Production code mutates inner dictionaries through shallow all_bindings() bypassing future policy enforcement; a narrow mutation operation must become the supported seam

Lifecycle operations must preserve at-most-one identity through targeted reverse-key cleanup and maintain existing failure semantics (confirmed 404 grace, moved-key repair, retirement fail-open, live corruption fail-closed, append-only comments)
The public facade must retain all existing method signatures and all_bindings() shallow semantics while delegating state changes through a private lifecycle policy coordinator
A narrow operation BindingStore.note_rich_emit() must preserve current hash/counter and save behavior with fail-open for missing bindings
No behavior changes to identity markers, schema, copy depth, corruption disposition, or lifecycle thresholds are permitted in this extraction slice
